capabilities.name: Buy inside an AI assistant
capabilities.question: Can an AI assistant buy from a merchant for you without you leaving the chat?

US.note: Google AI Mode and Gemini (agentic checkout and Universal Cart), Microsoft Copilot Checkout, Perplexity Instant Buy with PayPal and Alexa+ shopping all work for US users; ChatGPT Instant Checkout launched in the US but OpenAI moved checkout to merchant apps in March 2026.

GB.note: Only Alexa+ early access (invite or new Echo buyers, since March 2026) can order from Amazon by voice; Google says UCP checkout in AI Mode and Gemini will reach the UK after Canada and Australia, and Copilot, Perplexity and Google checkout are US-only.

DE.note: Only Alexa+ is available, in early access since May 2026, and Amazon does not list its shopping features by country; Google agentic checkout leaves Europe out (US and Australia only).

capabilities.name: Marketplace agent buys for you
capabilities.question: Can a marketplace's own AI agent buy things for you?

US.note: Amazon's Alexa for Shopping (with Rufus) can auto-buy at a set price for all US customers, Walmart's Sparky auto-reorders repeat items, and Amazon Buy for Me (buying from other brand sites) is still a beta for some US users.

evidence.title: Alexa for Shopping
Amazon Shopping app Buy for Me
Walmart's Sparky agent drives AI sales

GB.note: Only Amazon's Alexa+ in early access can order from Amazon for you; Rufus works in the UK, but its Auto Buy and Buy for Me are documented only in the US.

evidence.title: Alexa+ international launch
Alexa for Shopping (US only)

DE.note: Only Amazon's Alexa+ in early access (since May 2026); Rufus is live in Germany, but its Auto Buy is documented only in the US.

evidence.title: Alexa+ international launch

BR.note: Only Amazon's Alexa+ in early access (since June 2026); Mercado Libre is testing a shopping assistant and has registered the MAGO name for a buying agent, but neither is launched.

evidence.title: Alexa+ international launch
Mercado Libre prepara una IA que compra, invierte y paga por vos

MX.note: Only Amazon's Alexa+ in early access (since January 2026); no Mercado Libre or Walmart Mexico agent that buys for you was found.

evidence.title: Alexa+ international launch

CL.note: No marketplace buying agent found: Falabella is only exploring agents, Mercado Libre's buying agent is not launched, and Alexa+ is not in Chile.

evidence.title: Mercado Libre IA: claves para el futuro del retail 2026

CO.note: No marketplace buying agent found: Mercado Libre's buying agent is not launched and no Rappi or Falabella buying agent was found.

IN.note: Flipkart's payments app super.money started rolling out agents that shop on Flipkart in September 2026, and Amazon's Alexa+ (with shopping) is in early access; neither has reached all users yet. Amazon India's Rufus only sends deal alerts, with no Auto Buy.

capabilities.name: Merchants sell to AI agents
capabilities.question: Can local merchants sell to AI agents through an open protocol or platform?

US.note: US merchants can sell to agents through Shopify Agentic Storefronts (ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini, Copilot, Meta), Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite, PayPal Agent Ready and Store Sync, and Google UCP; OpenAI ACP product feeds need approval.

evidence.title: Agentic storefronts

GB.note: UK merchants can onboard to Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite (GB is on its country list) and to Shopify Agentic Storefronts, but the agents that buy mostly serve shoppers in the US, Canada and Australia; Google UCP checkout for UK shoppers is only announced.

evidence.title: Sell through agents with Agentic Commerce Suite (supported countries)

DE.note: German merchants can onboard to Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite (DE is on its country list) and to Shopify Agentic Storefronts, but the agents that buy mostly serve shoppers in the US, Canada and Australia.

evidence.title: Sell through agents with Agentic Commerce Suite (supported countries)

BR.note: Only Brazilian Shopify stores can sell through Agentic Storefronts, and only to shoppers in the US (ChatGPT, Copilot) or the US, Canada and Australia (Google); Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite does not list Brazil.

MX.note: Only Mexican Shopify stores can sell through Agentic Storefronts, and only to shoppers in the US, Canada or Australia; Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite does not list Mexico.

CL.note: Only Chilean Shopify stores can sell through Agentic Storefronts, and only to shoppers in the US, Canada or Australia; no local agentic commerce rail was found.

CO.note: Only Colombian Shopify stores can sell through Agentic Storefronts, and only to shoppers in the US, Canada or Australia; no local agentic commerce rail was found.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.role: Co-created the Agentic Commerce Protocol and lets ChatGPT buy from merchants, now mainly through merchant apps, plus a UPI pilot in India.

companies.name: Google
companies.role: Runs agentic checkout and Universal Cart in AI Mode and Gemini on its open Universal Commerce Protocol, and is testing Flipkart checkout in India.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.role: Copilot Checkout lets US shoppers buy from PayPal, Stripe and Shopify merchants inside Copilot.

companies.name: Perplexity
companies.role: Instant Buy lets US users pay merchants with PayPal inside Perplexity answers.

companies.name: Amazon
companies.role: Alexa+ and Alexa for Shopping (with Rufus) order, auto-buy and use Buy for Me on other sites for customers; outside the US Alexa+ is in early access.

companies.name: Walmart
companies.role: Sparky, Walmart's shopping agent, automatically reorders repeat items for customers.

companies.name: Flipkart (super.money)
companies.role: Flipkart's payments app super.money is rolling out agents that shop on Flipkart for users, and Flipkart is Google's checkout test partner in Gemini.

companies.name: Razorpay
companies.role: Agentic Payments lets Indian merchants take UPI payments from ChatGPT and Claude in a pilot.

companies.name: NPCI
companies.role: Runs UPI, whose Reserve Pay and UPI Circle features let AI agents pay without a PIN prompt each time, in pilot.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.role: Claude can order from Zomato, Swiggy and Zepto with UPI in an Indian pilot.

companies.name: Stripe
companies.role: Agentic Commerce Suite and Shared Payment Tokens let merchants list products for agents and accept agent payments.

companies.name: Shopify
companies.role: Agentic Storefronts puts store catalogs into ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini, Copilot and Meta Muse, for stores in any country selling to US, Canadian or Australian shoppers.

companies.name: PayPal
companies.role: Agent Ready and Store Sync let PayPal merchants be found and paid in Copilot, Perplexity and Google AI checkout.

companies.name: Meta
companies.role: The Muse agent can shop and pay through Stripe Link and Shopify connectors in the US and Canada.

companies.name: Mercado Libre
companies.role: Is testing a shopping assistant and a planned buying agent (MAGO) for its marketplace and Mercado Pago; nothing has launched in the target countries yet.
